# Supplier Continuous Monitoring

## Purpose

Define how material supplier risk is reviewed after initial onboarding.

## Monitoring signals

Depending on risk, monitoring MAY consider:

- material security or privacy incidents;
- assurance-report or certification changes;
- service outages and resilience performance;
- ownership or subcontractor changes;
- major product or data-handling changes;
- vulnerability or end-of-support information;
- contractual breaches;
- concentration and exit risk.

## Cadence

Review frequency should reflect impact, data access, dependency criticality,
and change rate.

## Escalation

Material deterioration in supplier risk requires remediation, compensating
controls, reduced dependency, replacement planning, or explicit risk
acceptance.

Initial due diligence does not permanently validate a supplier.
